data.long_meaning: The name Saakethika is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words Saaketha (protectress) and Ika (one). This name signifies the Goddess who protects and nurtures her devotees with unwavering devotion and strength. It is also believed to be a name of Lakshmi, the Goddess of Wealth, signifying her protective and nurturing nature.
